outcome: Accuracy of 3T-MR-DTI in assessing caesarean scars
Thickness of myometrium at scar level
cohort: 30 women with prior caesarean section and 12 women with prior vaginal delivery
finding: 3T-MR-DTI is valuable for evaluating muscle fibre remaining at the caesarean scar level, particularly in identifying retracting scars and quantifying fibre reduction.
